tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// byams pa la bstod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ byams pa'i thugs kyis byang chub thugs bskyed nas// byams brtse'i mkhyen pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad de// byams pas dga' ldan lha yi tshogs skyong ba// byams mgon rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyis// skye dgu rnams la mchog gi 'bras stsol zhing*// g.yon pas klu shing me tog legs bsnams pa// byams mgon rgyal ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ral pa'i thor tshugs mchod rten gyis mdzes shing*// ril ba spyi blugs las byung dag byed kyis// rul dang myags pa'i dri ma rnam sbyong ba// rol pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod phyir thogs dang khri snyan sā le yi// pags pa'i chos gos mchog gi rtags kyis ni// dka' thub mthar phyin par ni zhal bzhes pa// drang srong mchog la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba'i 'dam las nges par brgal ba khyod// 'dam skyes gdan la bzhengs nas zhi ba yi// spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs pas zhi mdzad pa// skye dgu'i gnyen gcig khyod la skyabs su mchi// khyod la 'dun pa'i yid kyis dbang bgyis nas// khyod sku rin chen mchog las legs bzhengs pa'i// sku 'di khyod nyid lags par legs bar bsams nas// shin tu dwang ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyis// ye shes gzigs pa'i dam pas nyer gzigs la// thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyis rab dgongs te// phrin las rgya mtsho rgya mtsho ltar bsdus nas// nyid ji bzhin du byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar thugs dam brtan pas byin rlabs pa'i// sku 'di nyid gcig kho nar ma bas te// dbyings dang mdzad pa gcig phyir rgyal ba kun// gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo nyid lags grang*// de 'dra mthong ba'i mig de dpal ldan zhing*// de la 'dun pa'i 'dun pa dpal 'bras can// mchod pas mchod bya ji bzhin mchod byed de// mchod 'os rnams kyi mchod par 'gyur lags grang*// de las dge ba rgya mtsho gang bskrun pas// 'di 'dra gang gi dpal las byung gyur pa'i// rgyal po dam pa gser mchog dpal dang bcas// rgyu sbyor byed pa ston tshul zhes bya ba// de yis dmigs bya rdo rje chos skyong gis// nye bar bsrungs pa'i chos skyong srung ma rnams// tshe 'dir tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas// skye ba kun du lha mi'i dpal rgyas la// dga' mgur spyad nas byams mgon chos kyi rje// chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyal thabs mdzad pa'i tshe// chos kyi rgyal srid yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor du// nye bar zhugs nas thub de sras dang bcas// mchod sprin rgya mtshos kun nas legs mchod de// chos tshul rgya mtsho thos shing legs rtogs nas// de yi ye shes gzigs pa nyer zhugs te// byang chub dam par lung bstan thob par shog

/de skad smras te smra ba rnams kyi rje// chos rje sa skya pa zhes yongs grags pa'i// zhabs kyi pad+mo spyi bos gus blangs pa// dge slong 'phags pa zhes byar grags pa la// grub pa dpal zhes bya bas gsol btab nas// me pho byi ba'i dpyid zla 'bring po yi// nyi shu bdun la gru mur zhes bya bar// yud tsam nyid la nye bar sbyar ba yin// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
